# The Breaking of Ostmere

> The Breaking of Ostmere (Ostmere for short) is a story-driven idle game that runs in the browser, currently in alpha. The grey comes down all day, and nobody sweeps it.

- [Play Ostmere](https://ostmere.yggdrasil.pub/): the game itself
- [Privacy](https://ostmere.yggdrasil.pub/privacy): what the game keeps about you, why, and for how long
